components.name: Primary Button
components.description: A tactile lavender action for saving settings or committing the next available step.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--color-accent); color: var(--color-deep); padding: 10px 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; font: 600 10px var(--font-mono); cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 3px 0 var(--color-accent-low), 0 8px 16px -6px rgba(145,132,217,.6); transition: filter .2s ease, transform .2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-amber); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A restrained surface control for secondary actions in dense panels.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: var(--color-surface-2); color: var(--color-text); padding: 5px 9px; border: 1px solid var(--color-line); border-radius: 6px; font: 600 10px var(--font-mono); cursor: pointer; box-shadow: var(--shadow-z1); transition: background .2s ease, border-color .2s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--color-surface-3); border-color: var(--color-accent-low); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-amber); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: The standard information container for findings, status, and compact lists.
components.html:
FINDINGS PACK

Population evidence stays distinct from your Personal History.
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 12px; border-radius: 16px; background: var(--color-surface); box-shadow: var(--shadow-z1); } .ds-card-kicker { color: var(--color-dim); font: 700 9.5px/1.2 var(--font-mono); letter-spacing: .11em; } .ds-card-copy { margin: 8px 0 0; color: var(--color-soft-text, #cfd3e5); font: 400 10.5px/1.5 var(--font-sans); }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: A compact pill for selected context or short semantic state.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 5px 11px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--color-accent-low); color: var(--color-chip-text); font: 600 10px var(--font-mono); letter-spacing: .04em; } .ds-chip-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--color-accent); box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--color-accent); }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: A compact route row that makes current context and system status scannable together.
components.html: Live matchHistory
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; padding: 2px 16px 10px; } .ds-nav a { min-height: 24px; padding: 5px 11px; border-radius: 999px; font: 600 10px var(--font-mono); text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-active { background: var(--color-accent); color: var(--color-deep); box-shadow: 0 3px 0 var(--color-accent-low), 0 8px 16px -6px rgba(145,132,217,.6); } .ds-nav-idle { background: var(--color-surface-2); color: var(--color-dim); box-shadow: var(--shadow-z1); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-amber); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Field
components.description: A compact deep-field input for Riot identity and sync settings.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; color: var(--color-dimmer); font: 700 9px var(--font-mono); letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-field input { min-height: 24px; padding: 6px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--color-line); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--color-deep); color: var(--color-text); font: 400 11px var(--font-mono); outline: none; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--color-accent); outline: 2px solid var(--color-amber); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
Bhayanak Legends is a compact instrument panel for high-context decisions. Its visual language is dense but calm: dark tonal layers keep attention on Findings Pack evidence, Personal History, and live status rather than on decoration. Inter Variable carries readable explanatory copy; JetBrains Mono makes labels, champion names, metrics, and state changes feel precise and inspectable.

The system uses restrained gradients, rounded cards, pill-shaped status controls, and small luminous state markers. Elevation is tactile rather than theatrical: surfaces step from deep canvas to raised container, while shadows give active or important panels a measured lift. The intended voice is research-led and confident without pretending that population evidence is certainty.
keyCharacteristics: Dark tonal layering with a lavender primary signal and disciplined semantic accents.
Compact monospace labels paired with short, readable explanatory copy.
Rounded cards and pills that make dense information feel touchable and organized.
Status colors communicate connection, evidence, caution, and personal trajectory.
Calm, research-led presentation; avoid glossy esports spectacle and noisy dashboard ornament.

rules.name: The Two-Data-Worlds Rule
rules.body: Teal describes the player's Personal History and live confirmation; blue describes Findings Pack population evidence. Do not blur the two.

rules.name: The Readout Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Use scale, weight, and monospace contrast to make the next decision obvious; do not solve hierarchy with oversized marketing headlines.

rules.name: The Layer-Before-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Establish hierarchy with surface color first; use shadow to reinforce it, not to rescue a flat or ambiguous layout.

dos: Do keep the deep midnight canvas visible around tonal surface tiers.
Do use JetBrains Mono for compact labels, champion names, percentages, and state readouts.
Do reserve Instrument Lavender for the current route, selected role, and primary action.
Do keep Findings Pack provenance visible when showing population numbers.
Do use teal, blue, amber, and rose as semantic signals with restrained coverage.
Do preserve the amber focus outline and minimum interactive target sizes.
donts: Don't use glossy esports spectacle, neon rainbow gradients, or decorative noise as a substitute for hierarchy.
Don't present Findings Pack population values as if they were the user's Personal History.
Don't turn every card into a raised or glowing surface; tonal layering is the default.
Don't use imperative copy for Diagnostic findings; phrasing discipline belongs to product behavior as well as presentation.
Don't render enemy summoner names in champ select UI or introduce enemy ability/ult timers.
